text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was super strong, but I managed 
to win! Helios-san even did that... 
"katan" thing for me?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Zephyr-san congratulated me too, but... 
she seemed a bit off...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
“For now, though, Trainer... Please, eat 
whatever you'd like as a celebration♪”
